h1: Palisades Tahoe ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Palisades Tahoe is two mountains on one pass above Lake Tahoe. The Palisades side holds 3,600 acres, 187 trails and sixteen bowls; Alpine holds 2,400 acres, 109 trails and seven. Both average 400 inches of snow a year, and the Palisades side hosted the 1960 Winter Olympics.
stayOverview: Olympic Valley is the Palisades base and where the 1960 Games were held; Alpine Meadows is the quieter second mountain; Tahoe City on the lake shore sits between them.
hotelIntro: Book against high season and pick the mountain you want at the door - the two bases are a shuttle ride apart even though the pass covers both.
rentalCars: Reno airport is about 45 miles away, and a car is useful for moving between the two bases and the lake.
